<h2>Save Trait Review Candidates</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Writes a generated trait-review queue and returns its path for a
'targets' file target.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>save_trait_review_candidates(
  data_trait_review_candidates,
  path_trait_review_candidates
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_review_candidates">data_trait_review_candidates</code></td>
<td>
<p>Candidate tibble from [build_trait_review_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_trait_review_candidates">path_trait_review_candidates</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar output CSV path.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The normalized output path.
</p>
